description: Artistic quality constraints for cinematic orchestration. These constraints influence planning, validation, review scoring, and execution guidance. Violating a REQUIRED constraint is a blocking error. Violating a RECOMMENDED constraint generates a review warning.

global.description: Constraints that apply to every cinematic orchestration regardless of workflow type.
required: Never generate uniform, symmetric FX — always introduce variation at multiple scales.
Never use default parameter values for simulation nodes in hero shots.
Always decompose multi-stage FX goals — never single-shot full-scene generation.
Simulation always precedes lighting which always precedes camera which always precedes render.
Every volume element must have at least one turbulence or noise layer.
recommended: Prefer layered workflows over monolithic node networks.
Preview before executing — always validate resource cost.
Use semantic workflow names when logging — not raw node types.

required: Fireball must have minimum 3 distinct temperature zones: core, mid, outer.
Smoke must have asymmetric breakup — no uniform puffball allowed.
Pressure-wave dust must be present at ground level.
Secondary debris must be present — minimum 2 scale categories.
Cinematic lighting is required — default lighting is not acceptable.
Ground interaction must be simulated — explosion cannot float above terrain.
Fireball must precede smoke in orchestration order.
Smoke simulation must have at least 2 turbulence frequency layers.
recommended: Consider camera anticipation hold of at least 12 frames before event.
Add pressure wave timing offset of 8–15 frames after fireball peak.
Include secondary ignition from debris impacts.
Use volumetric lighting to enhance smoke depth.
Slow-motion reveal camera pass for hero detail shots.

scale_constraints.description: Explosion radius drives simulation resolution and camera distance.

timing_constraints.description: All timing in frames at 24fps. Adjust proportionally for other rates.

review_criteria: Fireball reads as luminous and hot — not a flat sphere.
Smoke has visible asymmetry and scale variation.
Pressure wave visible at ground plane.
Debris scale varies — not uniform size.
Lighting creates cinematic contrast — not flat ambient.

required: Impact flash must be 2–6 frames maximum — no slow extended flash.
Ejecta must have outward-upward cone directionality.
Smoke column must have initial upward momentum.
Shockwave ring must be present at ground plane.
recommended: Sub-frame motion blur on fast-moving ejecta.
Dark smoke boundary for fuel-type impacts.
Camera positioned at ground level for maximum impact read.
review_criteria: Flash is fast — not slow or extended.
Ejecta travels outward and upward — not just upward.

required: Debris must have minimum 3 distinct scale categories (hero, mid, fine).
Tumbling rotation must be present — no translation-only motion.
Distribution must be uneven — not radially uniform.
Closest debris pieces must be largest — perspective scale correctness.
recommended: Dust trail on large pieces for visual trail.
Secondary bounce simulation for large hero chunks.
Material variation — not all pieces same surface type.
review_criteria: Large pieces near camera, small pieces far.

required: Wave must hug ground — initial height maximum 2m.
Leading edge must be sharp — not diffuse from start.
Dissipation must be gradual — not instant cutoff.
Color must match terrain context — not pure white.
recommended: Terrain-following deformation on leading edge.
Thin secondary layer at 0.2m height for ground-hugging feel.
Wind influence for directional asymmetry.

required: Key-to-fill ratio must be minimum 4:1 for cinematic contrast.
Rim light must separate hero elements from background.
Volumetric atmosphere must be present — no flat lit volumes.
Shadow penumbra must be present — no hard-edge shadows on organic elements.
Exposure must be set explicitly — do not rely on Arnold defaults.
recommended: Use HDRI for base environmental lighting before adding hero lights.
Warm key + cool fill for classic cinematic look.
Light linking to control which elements receive which lights.
AI denoiser for preview renders.
review_criteria: Rim light visible on hero elements.
Exposure is balanced — highlights and shadows both readable.

required: Godrays must be visible through smoke/dust volumes.
Volumetric shadows must be cast from pyro onto ground.
Light must have strong directional character — not ambient only.
Color temperature must vary — warm vs. cool separation.
recommended: Directional light angle matched to HDRI key direction.
Light scattering coefficient tuned per volume density.
Secondary bounce fill to recover shadow detail.

required: Anticipation hold must be minimum 12 frames before event.
Camera velocity must accelerate — not constant.
Hero element must be framed in readable position throughout move.
Slight rotation during push creates parallax depth.
Camera must not exceed FX bounding volume.
recommended: Ease-in and ease-out on camera path.
Slight Dutch tilt on recoil for impact emphasis.
Frame range at least 3x the push duration for settle.
review_criteria: Anticipation hold present and minimum 12 frames.

required: Impact frame must have maximum displacement — 5–10% of frame height.
Decay must feel physically weighted — not linear falloff.
High-frequency component on impact, low-frequency on residual.
Camera must not return exactly to pre-impact position.
recommended: Add subtle focus breathing on impact frame.
Micro-jitter on pre-event anticipation build.
Slightly different shake axis for each impact event.
review_criteria: High vs low frequency character changes.

required: AA samples minimum 3 for preview, 8 for final.
Motion blur must be enabled — not disabled.
Volume step size must be explicitly set — not auto.
Output directory must be set — not default temp path.
Frame range must match simulation range.
recommended: Enable AI denoiser for faster preview convergence.
Adaptive sampling with low noise threshold for volume.
Tile size 64x64 for GPU render, 32x32 for CPU.
Check memory estimate before final submission.

required: Beauty pass must be present.
Emission AOV required for all volumetric elements.
Cryptomatte required for per-element masking.
Depth pass must be in world units — not normalized.
All passes must be 16-bit or 32-bit EXR — no 8-bit.
recommended: Separate diffuse and specular indirect passes for relighting flexibility.
Motion vector pass in world space for post motion blur.
Normal pass in world space for relighting in comp.
Separate AOV per major FX element — smoke, fire, debris.
review_criteria: All passes are EXR — not PNG/JPG.

constraint_categories.required: Blocking — orchestration must satisfy this before proceeding.
constraint_categories.recommended: Advisory — review will flag if violated but execution continues.
constraint_categories.technical_requirements: Hard system requirements — missing capabilities block the workflow.
constraint_categories.review_criteria: Review engine scoring dimensions — each maps to a review comment.
